verdict.summary: Scanned pi-lean-ctx scoped package files under the package-vetter rubric: package metadata, README, and the TypeScript extension surfaces. I found two R-07 tool-description smuggling warnings where registered tool descriptions give imperative model-facing tool-use instructions; no override, role-hijack, system-token, exfiltration, authority-appeal, or encoded-smuggle findings were observed.

retrospective.workedWell: The package was small and the relevant files were easy to enumerate from package.json#pi.extensions plus the README and TypeScript extension files.
retrospective.confusing: R-07 is somewhat ambiguous for benign replacement-tool guidance: descriptions like 'ALWAYS use ctx_read instead of cat/head/tail' are model-facing imperatives, but they also describe the intended safe/efficient use of replacement tools.
retrospective.magicWand: Add a package-vetter helper command that prints the exact scoped file list and extracts registerTool/defineExtension description strings with line spans, so agents can scan the intended prompt-bearing text without manually distinguishing code from tool metadata.

coordination.notes: No peer coordination was used for this one-shot scan.

difficulties.description: The scope distinction between package.json-referenced extension files and generic TypeScript files required judgment: referenced extension files are code, but the rubric mainly treats TypeScript as in-scope only for registerTool/defineExtension descriptions.
difficulties.workaround: Read the extension files but only recorded findings against prompt-bearing registerTool descriptions, documenting the ambiguity in the retrospective.

findings.msg: tool description imperative: 'Do NOT use ctx_shell to read files (cat/head/tail) - use ctx_read instead'
findings.snippet: Output is auto-compressed by lean-ctx. IMPORTANT: Do NOT use ctx_shell to read files (cat/head/tail) - use ctx_read instead. Do NOT use ctx_shell for grep/find/ls

findings.msg: tool description imperative: 'ALWAYS use ctx_read instead of cat/head/tail via ctx_shell'
findings.snippet: description: "Read file contents. ALWAYS use ctx_read instead of cat/head/tail via ctx_shell. "

findings.msg: R-07 ambiguity: benign replacement-tool descriptions intentionally instruct tool choice, but still match imperative-to-LLM shape.
findings.snippet: ctx_shell and ctx_read descriptions tell the model not to use shell file-reading and to prefer ctx_read.
